definition_zh: 赤褐色的；红褐色的（多指头发）
definition_en: of hair, of a warm reddish-brown color; also used of other things with that shade
core_image: 秋阳里栗子壳那种又红又褐的颜色，铺在一头长发上
scene: 秋阳斜照进车厢，邻座姑娘的长发泛着栗壳般的光。A girl with auburn hair fell asleep against the train window.
sceneCN: 这里 auburn 指「赤褐色的」（第 1 个义项：发色）；句意：一个赤褐色头发的姑娘靠着车窗睡着了。画面里有秋阳、车窗和飘落的叶子。

derivatives.zh: 留赤褐色头发的（复合形容词）
披着赤褐色头发的（文学性复合词）

senses.title: Reddish-brown hair
senses.definition: of hair, of a warm color between red and brown
senses.definitionCN: （头发）介于红与褐之间的暖色调的
senses.example: She dyed her hair a deep auburn for the play.
senses.exampleCN: 为了这出戏她把头发染成了深赤褐色。
senses.why: The word narrowed early: hair was where English speakers kept meeting this exact shade, so the hair sense became the head sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词很早就收窄了：说英语的人在头发上最常遇到这种色度，发色义于是成了头号义项。

senses.title: The color itself
senses.definition: the reddish-brown color, used as a noun
senses.example: The painter mixed a perfect auburn on the palette.
senses.exampleCN: 画家在调色板上调出一种恰到好处的赤褐色。
senses.why: Color words slide between adjective and noun without effort; auburn took both seats.
senses.whyCN: 颜色词在形容词与名词之间滑动毫不费力；auburn 两个位子都坐了。

senses.title: Autumn objects
senses.definition: of leaves, cloth, or other things, of that warm red-brown shade
senses.definitionCN: （叶子、布料等）呈那种暖红褐色的
senses.example: Auburn leaves covered the steps of the old house.
senses.exampleCN: 赤褐色的落叶铺满了老宅的台阶。
senses.why: Once a color is fixed in the mind, anything wearing that color borrows the word.
senses.whyCN: 一种颜色在心中固定后，凡披着这颜色的东西都可以借用它的名字。

senses.title: Golden brown, in older use
senses.definition: in older use, of a yellowish or whitish-brown shade, closer to blond
senses.definitionCN: 旧时指偏黄或偏白的褐色，接近金发色
senses.example: In the old ballad the heroine has auburn, that is golden, hair.
senses.exampleCN: 在古老的民谣里，女主角有一头金褐色的头发。
senses.why: The word descends from a word for blond or whitish; the redder meaning grew later by folk linking with brown.
senses.whyCN: 这个词源自指金发或浅色的词；更红的意义是后来经与 brown 的民间联想才长出来的。

senses.title: Warm interior tones
senses.definition: of interiors or design, of warm brown-red tones
senses.definitionCN: （室内或设计）用暖红褐色调的
senses.example: The study was painted in quiet auburn tones.
senses.exampleCN: 书房刷成了安静的赤褐色调。
senses.why: Design borrows hair and autumn words because they already carry warmth and depth.
senses.whyCN: 设计界借用发色与秋天的词，因为这些词自带温度与厚度。

senses.title: In names
senses.definition: appearing in place names and brand names as a color word
senses.definitionCN: 作为颜色词出现在地名与品牌名中
senses.example: They stayed at a hotel called Auburn House.
senses.exampleCN: 他们住在一家名叫「赤褐居」的旅馆。
senses.why: Pleasant color words are safe building blocks for names, so auburn traveled into signage.
senses.whyCN: 悦目的颜色词是起名的安全砖块，auburn 于是走进了招牌。

senses.title: Dyed or natural
senses.definition: of a hair color, whether natural or dyed
senses.definitionCN: 指发色，无论天生还是染成
senses.example: Half the auburn heads in the room came out of a bottle.
senses.exampleCN: 屋里一半的赤褐头发是染出来的。
senses.why: The word describes the visible color only; it never asks how the color arrived.
senses.whyCN: 这个词只描述可见的颜色，从不追问颜色是怎么来的。

senses.title: Animal coats
senses.definition: of the fur or coat of animals, reddish-brown
senses.example: The pony had an auburn coat that shone in the sun.
senses.exampleCN: 小马披着一身阳光下发亮的赤褐色皮毛。
senses.why: Once the shade is named, the animal kingdom is simply more material wearing it.
senses.whyCN: 色度一旦命名，动物王国不过是又一批披着这颜色的材料。

intro.en: Auburn is a color word with a strange past: it began as a word for blond or whitish, from Latin albus meaning white, and only turned red-brown in English by false association with brown.
intro.cn: auburn 是个来历奇怪的颜色词：它起初指金发或浅色，出自拉丁语 albus「白」；只是在英语里因与 brown 的民间误联才变成红褐色。

items.en: The root *albho- meant white; it gave Latin albus and the name Albion, the island of white cliffs.
items.cn: 词根 *albho- 意为「白」；它给出拉丁语 albus，也给了「白崖之岛」阿尔比恩的名字。

items.en: albus meant white or pale; the derivative alburnus meant whitish.
items.cn: 拉丁语 albus 意为「白的、灰白的」；派生词 alburnus 意为「偏白的」。

items.en: auborne was used of blond or light hair, on the Latin alburnus line.
items.cn: 古法语 auborne 用于金发或浅发，属拉丁语 alburnus 一系。

items.en: auborne entered English still meaning blond or yellowish-brown hair.
items.cn: auborne 进入英语时仍指金发或黄褐色的头发。

items.en: By the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries the ending was heard as brown, and the color slid to reddish-brown; this is a folk-etymological reshaping.
items.cn: 到 16 至 17 世纪，词尾被听成了 brown，颜色随之滑向红褐色；这是一次民间词源式的重塑。

items.en: Modern auburn is firmly the warm red-brown of hair, autumn leaves, and leather.
items.cn: 现代 auburn 稳稳指头发、秋叶与皮革那种暖红褐色。

note.en: Group one collects look-alikes from the albus family and the brown sound; group two collects neighboring hair colors.
note.cn: 第一组收 albus 家族及与 brown 音近的词；第二组收相邻的发色词。

entries.definition: the dark color whose sound reshaped the ending of auburn; the two words are not related.
entries.definitionCN: 棕色；正是它的读音重塑了 auburn 的词尾，两词并无亲缘。

entries.definition: a morning love song, from Old French aube, dawn; only the opening spelling is shared.
entries.definitionCN: 晨歌，出自古法语 aube「黎明」；只是拼写开头相似，词源不同。

entries.definition: a person or animal lacking pigment, from Latin albus, white.
entries.definitionCN: 白化者；白化动物，出自拉丁语 albus「白」。

entries.definition: a book for pictures or recordings; originally a blank white tablet.
entries.definitionCN: 相册；专辑；本义为空白的白色板子。

entries.definition: an inn, in French; the sound is close but the source is a different Germanic line.
entries.definitionCN: 法语「客栈」；读音相近，来源却是另一支日耳曼语。

entries.definition: a reddish-brown color, especially of horse coats.
reddish-brown with a rustic, earthy feel.
entries.definitionCN: 黄褐色；带乡土气息的红褐色。
姜黄色；鲜亮的橙红色发色。

entries.definition: a rich red-gold hair color, after the painter Titian.
entries.definitionCN: 金红色发色，源自画家提香笔下。

entries.definition: a brownish metallic color, often of tanned skin.
entries.definitionCN: 青铜色；古铜色，常指晒后的肤色。

normalIntro.en: auburn hides two clues: an old root meaning whitish, and a new ending heard as brown.
normalIntro.cn: auburn 藏着两条线索：一个意为「偏白」的老词根，和一个被听成 brown 的新词尾。

normal.en: auburn looks like au plus burn: a color like autumn leaves about to burn.
normal.cn: auburn 形似 au + burn：像快要烧起来的秋叶那种颜色。

normal.en: The albus family: albino, album, auburn, all once meant white or pale.
normal.cn: albus 家族：albino、album、auburn——都曾有「白、浅」之义。

normal.en: Auburn hair is chestnut plus a spark of red.
normal.cn: auburn 的头发是栗色再加一星红。

normal.en: Say Auburn House and you have already used it as a name.
normal.cn: 念一遍 Auburn House，你已经把它当名称用了。

normal.en: The burn ending is only a hearing, not a history.
normal.cn: -burn 这个词尾只是耳朵的错觉，不是历史。

abstract.en: Picture one long auburn braid moving slowly in autumn light.
abstract.cn: 想象秋光中一条赤褐色的长辫缓缓晃动。

abstract.en: The word itself changed from white to red, like a leaf turning.
abstract.cn: 这个词自己从白变红，像一片叶子转色。

abstract.en: Auburn is the color of a warm library: leather, wood, and old light.
abstract.cn: auburn 是一间暖书房的颜色：皮革、木头与旧日的光。

examples.en: The child inherited her mother's auburn hair.
examples.cn: 孩子继承了母亲赤褐色的头发。

examples.en: Auburn leaves drifted across the garden path.
examples.cn: 赤褐色的落叶飘过园中小径。

examples.en: He chose an auburn leather jacket, worn at the elbows.
examples.cn: 他挑了件肘部磨旧的赤褐色皮夹克。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥本」——奥，本堂神父一头红褐色的长发，秋日下格外好看

root: 一般认为出自拉丁语 albus「白」的派生一系（alburnus「偏白的」），经古法语 auborne（金发的、浅色的）进入英语；16 世纪后因与 brown 谐音而被民间词源重塑为「赤褐色」，旧义与新义并存，来源需谨慎表述。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one color as it travels: from blond origins to red-brown hair, then outward to leaves, rooms, and animal coats.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项追随一种颜色旅行：从金发的出身到红褐的头发，再向外走到秋叶、房间与兽毛。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the warm red-brown shine of hair in autumn light.
core.cn: 核心意象：秋光中头发泛起的暖红褐色光泽。

branches.en: HAIR, NATURAL OR DYED: the head sense that governs the word.
branches.cn: 发色，无论天生或染成：支配全词的头号义项。

branches.en: THE SHADE AS MATERIAL: the noun color and its use in rooms and design.
branches.cn: 作为材料的色度：颜色名词及其在室内与设计中的使用。

branches.en: NATURE WEARS IT: leaves in the lane and the coat of a pony.
branches.cn: 自然披上它：巷里的秋叶与小马的皮毛。

branches.en: THE OLD SENSE: blond and yellowish, the color the word used to be.
branches.cn: 旧义：金发与黄褐色，这个词从前的颜色。

branches.en: IN SIGNAGE: Auburn House and its cousins in names.
branches.cn: 招牌之中：Auburn House 及其名称亲戚。

intro.en: auburn is a single French borrowing, not a compound; its parts are the old root meaning whitish and the ending that English ears bent toward brown.
intro.cn: auburn 是一个法语借词而非复合词；其组成部分是意为「偏白」的老词根，和被英语耳朵拗向 brown 的词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin albus, white, is the anchor of the family: albino, album, albumen, and indirectly auburn.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 albus「白」是这个家族的锚：albino、album、albumen，以及间接的 auburn。

items.exampleCN: 古法语里的金褐色头发

items.meaning: a person or animal without pigment
a white tablet; later a book
poetic name for England, land of white cliffs
items.meaningCN: 英格兰的诗称，白崖之地
